OPTIMAL_HEALTH.mechanical_failure_mode: All diagnostic parameters are within normal operating ranges. No mixture error, no sensor anomaly, no misfire pattern, and no DTC evidence of any active fault. Engine is performing within calibration.
ui_remediation_steps: No immediate repair is required. Engine parameters confirm normal operation.
Document the gas analyser readings and OBD PIDs as a baseline if this is a periodic service check — this establishes a healthy reference for future comparison.

If the vehicle was brought in for a specific symptom (rough idle, intermittent warning light), consider that the fault may be intermittent and not present during this test session. Schedule a retest under the conditions that trigger the symptom.
Advise normal service intervals and next scheduled maintenance.
